brief_rationale: The doctor met all responsibility-chain duties including active symptom screening, medication safety boundary clarification, and executable follow-up planning. However, no high-order point was validly completed: HO1 was not triggered, HO2-HO3 did not achieve verification depth beyond minimum duty, and HO4 offered generic sequencing rather than personalized constraint navigation. The trajectory is safe and complete but capped at Acceptable.
